observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show a white industrial-style sewing machine on a matching white table with red accents.
The machine has a visible 'JUKI' logo on the side in blue letters.
The table has a ruler along the front edge and a red pedal at the base.
The machine appears to be outdoors on dirt ground with green foliage in the background.
There is visible wear and some dirt on the machine's surface, especially around the needle and base plate.
The machine has a large bobbin case and a handwheel on the right side.
No power cord is plugged in, and no lights or movement are visible.
The seller's watermark 'WINI BROWN' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are overlaid on both photos.

claims.evidence: The brand 'JUKI' is visible in both photos, but there is no visible proof of origin (UK) or condition (quality/used). The photos show wear, but not enough to confirm 'quality'.

risks.risk: machine may have hidden mechanical or electrical faults
risks.proof: close-up of the motor, wiring, and bobbin area, and a test run video

risks.risk: origin claim (UK-used) may be false or misleading

proof_requests: Video of the machine in operation, including pedal response and needle movement.
Close-up photos of the motor, wiring, and bobbin area.
Photo of the serial number or any identification plate on the machine.
Proof of origin if possible (e.g., receipt, import label).
response.reason: The brand JUKI is confirmed, but the condition, functionality, and origin claims are unverified. Without proof of operation and internal condition, the item cannot be priced accurately. The photos show wear, but no evidence of working state or provenance.
